war_summary: War 139 is on day 107 with no winner yet (32 victory towns required). The map remains heavily consolidated on the flanks — Colonials fully hold Acrithia, Dead Lands, Drowned Vale, Fisherman's Row and many rear hexes; Wardens fully hold Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Viper Pit, Reaching Trail, Weathered Expanse and others — while a handful of contested fronts drive nearly all activity. Compared to the previous snapshot (~3h ago), the biggest change is that Oarbreaker has surged to become the most active region (56 events/24h, 6 events in just the last 2 hours, heavy back-and-forth at Posterus, Grisly Refuge, Partisan Island), overtaking Endless Shore (47 events, still very hot at Woodbind, The Overland, Old Jack Tar). Godcrofts remains a tight 5-4 Warden-lead knife-fight with fresh activity in the last hour at Saegio and Argosa. Callahan's Passage shows massive accelerating casualties (~700+/hr per side) with recent flips at Overlook Hill and Scáth Passing. Clahstra (11 events) and Mooring County (12 events, Borderlane) show Colonial pressure but their latest events are several hours old; Stlican Shelf activity has cooled since the prior snapshot. Casualty rates are also spiking sharply in Marban Hollow, Olavis Wake (Ilmari Bridge flip), Onyx, Speaking Woods, and Pipers Enclave, indicating large battles even where capture events are sparse. Quiet rear regions remain static and unlikely to change hands.
